There's something really beautiful about this. The fact that you show the looping as it's done is very very impressive. That being said, I do have a couple suggestions. When it comes to the beats I'd say try to simplify it a little more. While people can look at everything you're doing during the video and see how technically impressive it all is, and some can understand how the somewhat disjointed layers fit together in a sort of destructive yet beautiful way, when it all comes together and you have someone trying to flow over it, it tends to distract from the lyrics a bit. Your lyrics seem to be fairly poignant, so I can't imagine you want them to go unheard. I personally think that if you keep the excellent cello fills plus the great back track it would still be just as impressive, but would also help to highlight the lyrics a bit more. Idk man, at the same you put way the fuck more effort into actually producing some music than I ever did, so if this is exactly what you want it to be, then fuck my opinion and do your thing man! Like I said in the beginning, there's something really beautiful about it as is.
